messages:
riley: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need the postmortem action items converted into concrete evals/tests by next sprint. putting a checklist here so owners can ack.

morgan: Agree. Proposed minimal scope: 1) regression suite for output correctness, 2) two prompt sets (customer-facing & safety edge cases), 3) short burst load test (simulated spike), 4) a focused chaos drill (node preempt + control-plane hiccup).

devin: I'll take the regression suite and the GH action matrix. Plan: add tests that validate exact-match for critical prompts, a token-diff detector, and a hallucination heuristic. Draft PR by Fri. `pytest tests/regression/test_incident_456.py::test_critical_prompts`

alejandra: I'll create the two prompt sets. One for billing/account flows (from error logs) and one for safety/backoff triggers. I'll include metadata fields: source, reproduction_steps, original_response snippet. Target: PR Monday.

tom: ops side: I'll schedule the chaos drill with eng-sre. Suggest 45m window Thursday 15:00 PDT, scope: evict one GPU pod, then fail control-plane replica. We'll run the drill against staging only. ops-bot can generate the invite.

morgan: We also need the load test: short 2-minute bursts, ramp to 200 qps, capture p50/p95/p99 and token-costs. Add it as a nightly job in CI but marked optional until reviewed.

riley: For traceability, add links back to postmortem issue #456 and include a CHANGELOG entry in infra/evals/changes/456-additions.md. Owners should post PRs there so the postmortem closes cleanly.

devin: Re variants: will run regression across model variants v1.4 and v1.4-quant. GH action will use `matrix: variant: [v1.4, v1.4-quant]`.

alejandra: For the prompt set format I'll follow existing schema: 
```
- id: incident-456/billing-edges
  prompts:
    - "why is my subscription missing"
    - "I can't see my invoice"
  tags: [billing, repro]
```
I'll also add a small script to anonymize PII from logs before committing.

morgan: Ownership summary:
- regression suite + GH matrix: devin
- prompt sets + anonymizer: alejandra
- load burst + CI job: riley
- chaos drill coordination: tom + eng-sre
- postmortem link + docs: morgan

riley: Deadlines: owners to open draft PRs and link to #456 by next Tue EOD. If you need more time, flag in this thread by EOD today.

devin: ack, will have draft by Fri and link to #456.

alejandra: ack, might need Tue morning to finish anonymizer tests. will flag if delayed.

tom: ops-bot: please create the calendar invite and add runbook link.

ops-bot: Invite created: Chaos drill (incident-456) Thu 22:00 UTC (45m). Runbook: https://go/drills/incident-456. Reminder 24h prior. :robot_face:

morgan: One more: add a small prefix-cache regression probe to the nightly evals (we saw cold-start tokenization spikes). script: `infra/evals/prefix_probe.py --model v1.4` — add to nightly.

riley: Great. We'll do a brief sync in the #eng-platform channel next Wednesday at 16:00 UTC to confirm PRs and drill readiness. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

devin: thanks.

alejandra: thanks.

tom: thanks.

ops-bot: Reminder will be sent 24h before drill.
